(Avk, = कुश; Chopra, = कुश; DWH 3, p. 575-577, = कुश; IRM 3, p. 43; KB 4, p. 2688-2689; V 3, p. 14; Vśs, = कुश) = BRIZA BIPINNATA LINN. = UNIOLA BIPINNATA LINN. = POA CYNOSUROIDES RETZ. (Avk; Dy, p. 854; Gul; Roxb., p. 112, = कुश; Vśs; Wise); (2) CYNODON DACTYLON (LINN.) PERS. [Intern. Code] (Viennot) = PANICUM DACTYLON LINN. (Goudr.); (3) SACCHARUM SPONTANEUM LINN. (Vśs: = काश). Many authors equate दर्भ with कुश, but Ḍa. (on Su.Sū. 38, 75) distinguishes them clearly: “कुश is short and soft and has leaves with the form of a needle; दर्भ has leaves which are broad, long and rough.”
